Trial type does not trim the selected interval or change coordinate calculations. All four types calculate trajectory, distance, speed, quadrant, wall-zone and platform metrics over the same interval. The type records how to interpret the results.

Hidden: Learn the location of a submerged platform using surrounding cues. Main measures are escape latency, path length, path efficiency and improvement across trials.
Probe: Remove the platform to assess memory of its previous location. Main measures are target-quadrant occupancy, crossings of the former platform location and mean proximity. Platform acquisition and latency are not primary measures.
Visible: Find a visible platform to assess vision, movement and motivation to swim. Main measures are latency and path length to the visible platform.
Reversal: Move the platform to a new location to assess cognitive flexibility: suppressing the old location and learning the new one. Examine latency and improvement across trials.

사용 체크한 Arena의 실제 트래킹 좌표에서 위치 판정에 사용할 점을:
Select points for position decisions from the included arenas' tracking coordinates. If results are unavailable, bodyparts from the current tracking model are shown. Original names and order are preserved.

A frame is valid only when every checked point passes the DLC confidence threshold. Their mean coordinate is used as the representative swimming position for distance, speed, quadrant and platform calculations.

One checked point gives the original single-point behavior. Multiple points can reduce transient jitter, but frequent occlusion of any point reduces valid-coordinate coverage. Start with the model's body-center point, then check valid-coordinate percentage and decision videos. If selected points are absent from analysis coordinates, check the model and tracking results.
선택한 신체점의 likelihood가 이 값보다 낮으면 해당 프레임의 좌: Coordinates are treated as missing when a selected point's likelihood falls below this value. A high threshold reduces coverage; a low threshold may include incorrect coordinates. Check valid-coordinate percentage and decision videos together.
신체점이 플랫폼 영역 안에 연속으로 머물러야 '플랫폼 도달'로 확정되는: Minimum continuous time inside the platform required to confirm acquisition. Brief passes and coordinate spikes are excluded. This affects acquisition and latency only; it does not shorten the selected analysis interval or decision video.
DLC 신뢰도가 낮아진 짧은 좌표 공백을 앞뒤 유효 좌표 사이의 직선으로: Maximum missing-coordinate duration to linearly interpolate between valid endpoints. Longer gaps remain missing. Excessively long interpolation can connect distant locations and distort path length.
플랫폼 영역 안에 연속으로 머문 시간이 이 값 이상일 때만 플랫폼 교차: Confirm a platform crossing only after continuous presence for this duration. This is separate from the 2-second acquisition dwell, preserving quick valid crossings while excluding one- or two-frame jitter. The recommended initial value for probe crossings is 0.3 seconds.
플랫폼을 통과하는 도중 좌표가 잠깐 플랫폼 밖으로 벗어난 간격이 이 값: Merge platform-presence intervals separated by an outside gap no longer than this value. The recommended initial value is 0.2 seconds to avoid merging distinct crossings. This is separate from coordinate interpolation by Bridge short gaps.
